purpose: Materialize one continuous common replication window from timestamp-only slot occupancy after V0.3 proved that millisecond settlement jitter caused false coverage failures and that 2024-08 contains a real missing Hyperliquid hourly settlement slot.

coverage_semantics.month_complete_rule: Use V0.3 unique nearest-scheduled-slot occupancy: exact expected slot count, zero missing slots, zero slot collisions, zero boundary-mapped-out records, zero ambiguous half-cadence mappings.
coverage_semantics.primary_window_rule: Among frozen months through 2025-12, choose the earliest common-complete full UTC month such that every subsequent month through 2025-12 is also common-complete across BINANCE_BTCUSDT, BINANCE_ETHUSDT, HYPERLIQUID_BTC and HYPERLIQUID_ETH.
coverage_semantics.equivalent_algorithm: Find the last month on or before 2025-12 that is not common-complete; primary_start is the immediately following calendar month. primary_end is 2025-12. Fail closed if primary_end is not common-complete or if no month remains.
coverage_semantics.reason: A static or deterministic low-turnover carry replication requires one continuous auditable settlement ledger; internal missing settlements cannot be interpolated or silently skipped.

decision_policy: V0.4 may freeze the provenance-only continuous replication partition. It cannot by itself mark G03/G04/G10 PASS, authorize Discovery, or evaluate economics.
